# PublicNode
> Fast, free, privacy-first RPC endpoints for more than 100 blockchains.

PublicNode provides public JSON-RPC and related Web3 infrastructure endpoints, with chain-specific documentation, network details, and connection information for developers integrating blockchain access.

## Documentation
- [Documentation Home](https://publicnode.com/docs): Main entry point for PublicNode documentation and chain connection details.
- [Supported Chains](https://publicnode.com/docs/supported-chains): Overview of available blockchain networks and their PublicNode endpoints.
- [FAQ](https://publicnode.com/docs/faq): Answers to common questions about usage, limits, privacy, and reliability.
- [Terms of Service](https://publicnode.com/terms): Terms governing use of PublicNode services and endpoints.
- [Privacy Policy](https://publicnode.com/privacy): Privacy practices for using PublicNode infrastructure and website services.

## EVM Networks
- [Ethereum RPC](https://publicnode.com/docs/ethereum): Endpoint details and network information for Ethereum mainnet access.
- [Base RPC](https://publicnode.com/docs/base): Public RPC connection details for the Base network.
- [BNB Smart Chain RPC](https://publicnode.com/docs/bsc): Public endpoint information for BNB Smart Chain integrations.
- [Polygon RPC](https://publicnode.com/docs/polygon): RPC access details for Polygon network applications.
- [Arbitrum RPC](https://publicnode.com/docs/arbitrum): PublicNode endpoint information for Arbitrum connectivity.
- [Optimism RPC](https://publicnode.com/docs/optimism): Network endpoint details for Optimism-based applications.
- [Avalanche C-Chain RPC](https://publicnode.com/docs/avalanche): Public RPC information for Avalanche C-Chain access.
- [Gnosis RPC](https://publicnode.com/docs/gnosis): Endpoint details for connecting to the Gnosis network.
